title: fix(lint,service-automation)!: a flow value envelope is typed for the date-text verdicts, so timestamp() over a date field is refused at os validate and registerFlow
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9USTJYAvMcxS7CFGZygeZG6)_

Fixes #34451
Completes #34661 (not closed by this PR: the seat closes it after merge).

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — narrowed: a flow value envelope (`assignment` values, `create_record` / `update_record` `fields.*`) that registered and published now refuses at `os validate` and at `registerFlow` when it hands `timestamp()` a date field (the date-text verdict family). Widened: the published `ExprSchemaHint` type gains one optional key, `flowValueEnvelope`.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no published skill teaches a flow value envelope over a date field; `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` already states the `timestamp()` / `date-text-call` rule without naming a site, so it now holds for value envelopes as written

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：flow 的值信封（`update_record` / `create_record` 的 `fields.*`、`assignment` 的值）在记录触发或对被定型对象的 sweep、且 flow 不自己重绑 `record`/`previous`（previous 只算节点绑定，声明的会被运行时覆盖）时，按触发对象的字段类型校验，只放行 date-text 这一族判词；`isoDate(timestamp(record.DATE_FIELD) + duration('168h'))` 这类写法在 `os validate` 和引擎 `registerFlow` 同时被拒，并提示改写为 `isoDate(addDays(record.DATE_FIELD, N))`；inbound hook、schedule、无触发或被父流程调用的 flow 不判。spec 的三条 ADR-0087 条目 surface 同步点名这个新位置（#34661）。
- 为什么改：日期字段运行时是 `YYYY-MM-DD` 文本，`timestamp()` 只认完整时间戳，这种写法过去校验通过、发布成功、每次运行都失败（cloud#4717 的现场）；#34447 的拒绝够不到值信封。
- 风险与回滚：收窄（BREAKING，按 minor 发布）：已存的、值信封里带这种写法的 flow 在挂了对象解析器的引擎上会注册失败，直到改写；只判 `record.FIELD` / `previous.FIELD` 读，其它类型判词不进值信封，运行时求值路径不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/formula/src/validate.ts`（`flowValueEnvelopeDateTextIssue` 与新 hint 键）、`packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-registration-checks.ts`（注册门传字段类型、存量预览也算）、`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`（`checkDeclaredValue`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/builtin/assignment-value-envelope.test.ts -t 34451`，预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的：受管面未触及；本 PR 是收窄，落地前需一次契约复审记录，由席位路由。

## What changes

A flow value envelope was validated with no field types, by `@objectstack/lint`'s `checkDeclaredValue` and by the engine's `valueEnvelopeRefusals` alike, so the date-text verdicts (#28944, #32595, #34447) never reached it. Measured on `origin/main` ffa6db19f before building: a record-triggered flow whose `update_record` writes `due_date` from `isoDate(timestamp(record.borrow_date) + duration('168h'))` got zero findings from `validateStackExpressions` and registered clean, in `update_record`, `create_record` and `assignment` alike.

Route A, as the seat named it: the date-text family only.

- `packages/formula/src/validate.ts`: `ExprSchemaHint` gains the optional `flowValueEnvelope` key. With it (and `fieldTypes`), the `value` role runs ONE schema-aware pass, `flowValueEnvelopeDateTextIssue`: the date-text check typed at `record` scope, so it judges `record.FIELD` / `previous.FIELD` reads only; the Timestamp-typing mismatch is asked first and stands it down (so `record.due_date + 1` and `record.title * 2` stay another family's and say nothing here); the result is kept only when its code is `date-text-call*` / `date-text-arithmetic*`, under the `run-may-fail` arm. A bare name and a source that reads `input` take no verdict. Field existence, the near-miss, the bare-reference refusal, `type-mismatch*`, `date-arithmetic*`, `date-duration-value` and the traversal arm all stand down. Without the key the call is unchanged.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`: `checkDeclaredValue` takes the field types of the object the flow's conditions are typed against (start `objectName`, else a time-relative flow's swept object) and passes the hint only where the run's `record` is that object's row: the same `faultOutcomeOf` set a flow condition's proven outcome uses (record-triggered, or a sweep of the typed object), and only while the flow rebinds neither `record` (any row of `collectFlowVariableNames`) nor `previous` (a node row only: the collector asked without `flow.variables`, since `seedRunVariables` sets `previous` over a declared variable). Every other flow's envelopes are judged untyped, as before.
- `packages/services/service-automation`: `valueEnvelopeRefusals(value, fieldTypes?)` passes the same hint when handed types. `validateFlowExpressions` hands it the resolver's field types for the bound object in BOTH modes, so `registerFlow` throws the refusal and the stored pass (`canonicalizeStoredFlow`) lists it at the slot; the binding is now derived in the stored mode too, so a time-relative flow is typed with its swept object there as well. The run-time evaluator still calls `valueEnvelopeRefusals(envelope)` untyped, unchanged. Three `engine.ts` docblocks that said "a resolver can never break a flow that used to register cleanly" now name this one exception. The typing is handed on only where `deriveTriggerBinding` gives record_change (string `triggerType`) or a time-relative sweep of the typed object, and `flowRebindsRunRowRoots` finds neither `record` (declared variable, node id, output / iterator / index / error variable, assignment target) nor `previous` (the same rows less the declared variable) via `flowNodeBoundNames`, so both doors judge one set. `plugin.ts`'s resolver wiring comment and debug line now say the same (L2 N2).
- `.changeset/34451-flow-value-envelope-date-text.md`: `minor` for `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/service-automation`, the declaration lines, **BREAKING** banner, FROM to TO table, ADR-0087 disposition `already-registered` naming the three semantic entries (`formula-timestamp-date-only-refused`, `formula-date-text-call-refused`, `formula-date-subtraction-refused`), whose `surface` this PR rewrites to name the value-envelope site, its scope (record-triggered or a sweep of the typed object, rebinding neither `record` nor `previous`), its boot-registration consequence, and an acceptance-criteria line telling an operator how to confirm a stored flow is clear (no "failed to register flow" warning at boot; no `registerFlow` TODO from `POST /api/v1/meta/_migrate-stored` on the running server — the CLI's `os migrate meta --stored` boots automation inert, `armRuntime: false`, with no object-schema resolver, so it types no value envelope and cannot show this); it states #34661 is completed by this PR.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.formula-timestamp-date-only-refused.ts`, `18.formula-date-text-call-refused.ts`, `18.formula-date-subtraction-refused.ts`: `surface` text only (seat ruling on L2 S1, option i). No generated file moves (`check:generated` 14/14 up to date).

## Tests

- `packages/formula/src/validate-date-text-arithmetic.test.ts`, new top-level describe: the measured expression refused under `date-text-call-run-may-fail` with its params (call, reference, rewrite, shift); the bare call, a `previous.FIELD` read and `record.borrow_date - duration('24h')`; CONTROL: a `datetime` field under `timestamp()` and the taught `addDays` shift stay clean; CONTROL: `record.title * 2`, `record.due_date + 1`, `today() - record.borrow_date` and an unknown field say nothing in an envelope while a formula site still reports `type-mismatch`; a bare name and an `input` read take no verdict; a malformed envelope is still refused, and no hint means no change.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts`, new top-level describe: `validateStackExpressions` refuses the measured expression and the bare call in `update_record`, `create_record` and `assignment`, at the slot's key path, naming the `addDays` shift; a time-relative flow is typed with its swept object; CONTROL: a `datetime` field and the taught shift are clean, and a text field in arithmetic stays silent in the envelope. CONTROLs for the stand-down, each carrying `timestamp(record.borrow_date)`: an inbound-hook (`api`) start, a start with no trigger, a schedule, a child flow a parent starts through `subflow`, a record-triggered flow declaring a `record` variable, and one whose assignment assigns `record`. For the no-trigger and schedule starts the lint CONTROL asserts the findings equal those of a bare `record.borrow_date` read (the existing unbound-root refusal, #22565) and carry no date-text verdict. Round 3: `record` bound through a get_record outputVariable, a loop iterator / index variable, a try_catch errorVariable, a node id, and assignment shapes 2 and 3, and a sweep whose start names another object, each a CONTROL; `timestamp(previous.borrow_date)` refused, and two `previous` CONTROLs (get_record `outputVariable: 'previous'`, an assignment building it); a declared `previous` still refused; field minus field refused.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/assignment-value-envelope.test.ts`, new top-level describe: `registerFlow` throws for all three slots, located and led by the published value-envelope sentence, naming the shift; the stored pass lists exactly the slot `registerFlow` refuses; a time-relative flow is typed with its swept object; CONTROL: `datetime`, a text field in arithmetic and `record.due_date + 1` still register; with no resolver nothing changes, and the evaluator's own call stays untyped. CONTROLs for the stand-down, each carrying `timestamp(record.borrow_date)`: an inbound-hook (`api`) start, a start with no trigger, a schedule, a child flow a parent starts through `subflow`, a record-triggered flow declaring a `record` variable, and one whose assignment assigns `record`. Each registers, with no stored todos. Round 3: `record` bound through a get_record outputVariable, a loop iterator / index variable, a try_catch errorVariable, a node id, and assignment shapes 2 and 3, and a sweep whose start names another object, each a CONTROL; `timestamp(previous.borrow_date)` refused, and two `previous` CONTROLs (get_record `outputVariable: 'previous'`, an assignment building it); a declared `previous` still refused; field minus field refused.
- No existing test changed: no test pinned the untyped value-envelope behaviour this narrows.

## Acceptance notes

- **The outcome clause says "condition".** The verdict rides the existing `-run-may-fail` codes, whose shared clause reads "when the condition runs ... a flow condition that cannot be evaluated fails the run". On a value envelope the run does fail at that node (the evaluator throws), but the sentence names a condition. A value-worded arm would be a new code in the refusal ledger, which this card does not decide; the location and the leading value-envelope sentence name the slot. Reported to the seat. Disposition: filed #34660.
- **Bare names stand down.** In a value envelope a bare name holds whatever the run's variable map holds; `@objectstack/lint` knows a flow's declared variables and open binders, the engine does not, and the two doors must refuse one set. So only `record.FIELD` / `previous.FIELD` reads are judged, at both doors.
- **`date-duration-value` stays out.** It is a date verdict outside the date-text family the ruling names.
- **ADR-0087.** The three registered entries carry the same verdicts, codes and rewrites; this PR rewrites their `surface` to name the flow value envelope (assignment values, create_record / update_record `fields.*`) within the stand-down scope (record-triggered flow or a time-relative sweep of the typed object, rebinding neither `record` nor `previous`), and the consequence: a stored flow carrying one fails to register at boot on an engine with the object-schema resolver wired until rewritten. For the subtraction entry only its first two shapes reach the envelope. Completes #34661 (not closed by this PR: the seat closes it after merge).
- **Found on the way (reported to the seat, not fixed here):** in a flow CONDITION (flattened scope) a `record.FIELD` read is not typed by the date-text check: a record-triggered start condition comparing `timestamp(record.borrow_date)` with `now()` gets zero findings from `validateStackExpressions`, while the same comparison over the bare `timestamp(borrow_date)` is refused. Disposition: filed #34662.
- **Stand-down residues (seat ruling).** (1) A screen field named `record` is not counted as the flow binding `record`, at either door, as lint's `declaredVariables` does not count screen fields: kept. (3) An open binder node (`script` and the like) could in principle rebind `record`; it is not counted, as lint's existing reading of `record.FIELD` in flow conditions keeps the row outcome (#30025): kept. (2) A record-triggered flow that a parent also starts through `subflow` / `map` is judged as if `record` were its trigger row, while on that entrance it is the parent's record. Disposition: filed #34694.
- **A declared `record` variable stands the envelope down.** Kept from the S2 ruling: on a record-triggered or sweep entrance `seedRunVariables` writes `record` over a declared variable, so counting a declared `record` only refuses less, never wrongly. A conservative under-refusal, accepted by the seat.
- **A `previous.F` read in a branch that never runs is refused too (L2 N8).** That is the scope of the published date-text rule itself, the same as on flow conditions on `main`; follows the published rule's scope, accepted by the seat, no card.
- Governed surfaces: none in the diff.
